verses.2:
He wraps Himself in light as with a garment;
 He stretches out the heavens like a tent,
verses.3:
laying the beams of His chambers
 in the waters above,
 making the clouds His chariot,
 walking on the wings of the wind.
verses.4:
He makes the winds His messengers,
 flames of fire His servants. + 104:4 LXX He makes His angels winds, His servants flames of fire. Cited in Hebrews 1:7|HEB 1:7
verses.5:
He set the earth on its foundations,
 never to be moved.
verses.6:
You covered it with the deep like a garment;
 the waters stood above the mountains.
verses.7:
At Your rebuke the waters fled;
 at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away —
verses.8:
the mountains rose and the valleys sank
 to the place You assigned for them —
verses.9:
You set a boundary they cannot cross,
 that they may never again cover the earth.
verses.10:
He sends forth springs in the valleys;
 they flow between the mountains.
verses.11:
They give drink to every beast of the field;
 the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
verses.12:
The birds of the air nest beside the springs;
 they sing among the branches.
verses.13:
He waters the mountains from His chambers;
 the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works.
verses.14:
He makes the grass grow for the livestock
 and provides crops for man to cultivate,
 bringing forth food from the earth:
verses.15:
wine that gladdens the heart of man,
 oil that makes his face to shine,
 and bread that sustains his heart.
verses.16:
The trees of the LORD have their fill,
 the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,
verses.17:
where the birds build their nests;
 the stork makes her home in the cypresses. + 104:17 Or pines or junipers or firs
verses.18:
The high mountains are for the wild goats,
 the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers. + 104:18 Or the coneys or the hyraxes
verses.19:
He made the moon to mark the seasons;
 the sun knows when to set.
verses.20:
You bring darkness, and it becomes night,
 when all the beasts of the forest prowl.
verses.21:
The young lions roar for their prey
 and seek their food from God.
verses.22:
The sun rises, and they withdraw;
 they lie down in their dens.
verses.23:
Man goes forth to his work
 and to his labor until evening.
verses.25:
Here is the sea, vast and wide,
 teeming with creatures beyond number,
 living things both great and small.
verses.26:
There the ships pass,
 and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.
verses.27:
All creatures look to You
 to give them their food in due season.
verses.28:
When You give it to them,
 they gather it up;
 when You open Your hand,
 they are satisfied with good things.
verses.29:
When You hide Your face,
 they are terrified;
 when You take away their breath,
 they die and return to dust.
verses.30:
When You send Your Spirit, + 104:30 Or breath 
 they are created,
 and You renew
 the face of the earth.
verses.31:
May the glory of the LORD endure forever;
 may the LORD rejoice in His works.
verses.32:
He looks on the earth,
 and it trembles;
 He touches the mountains,
 and they smolder.
verses.33:
I will sing to the LORD all my life;
 I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
verses.34:
May my meditation be pleasing to Him,
 for I rejoice in the LORD.
verses.35:
May sinners vanish from the earth
 and the wicked be no more.
 Bless the LORD, O my soul.
 Hallelujah! + 104:35 Or Hallelu YAH , meaning Praise the LORD
